text: 科创50指数半日跌超6%，创业板指跌近5%，全市场下跌个股近5000只。 芯片股抛售蔓延亚洲，日股跌逾2%，韩股跌逾5%。 特朗普推迟对加拿大征收50%关税三天，称美、加已达成协议。 报道：若特朗普升温战争，伊朗正考虑将欧洲境内的军事目标纳入打击范围。 宇树科技上市首日高开630%，中一签赚近50万元，梁文锋打新宇树科技浮盈11亿，雷军赚152亿，美团系浮盈333亿，大疆痛失超250亿。 中国首次实现运载火箭陆地回收！朱雀三号遥二一子级按预定程序成功软着陆。 嫦娥七号器箭组合体完成垂直转运，计划近日择机实施发射。 长江存储IPO辅导状态变更为“辅导验收”
text_en: STAR 50 index fell over 6% by midday, ChiNext dropped nearly 5%, with nearly 5,000 stocks declining across the market. Chip stock selloff spread across Asia, with Japan's Nikkei down over 2% and South Korea's KOSPI down over 5%. Trump delayed 50% tariffs on Canada for three days, saying the US and Canada reached a deal. Reports: Iran considering military targets in Europe within strike range if Trump escalates war. Unitree Robotics surged 630% on debut, with one lot earning nearly 500,000 yuan; Liang Wenfeng's IPO stake gained 1.1 billion yuan, Lei Jun gained 15.2 billion, Meituan-linked investors gained 33.3 billion, DJI missed out on over 25 billion. China's first land recovery of a carrier rocket! Zhuque-3 Y2 first stage successfully soft-landed as programmed. Chang'e-7 spacecraft-rocket combo completed vertical transfer, launch planned soon. YMTC's IPO coaching status changed to 'coaching acceptance'.
